events.content:
The reading log is ready. The home page shows separate **Currently reading** and **Finished** shelves. You can add a book with notes, mark it finished, and open its own page to view its details or copy a shareable link. Books are saved to `data/books.json` and remain there after a restart.

Run `npm start`, then open `http://localhost:3000`. Setup details are in the [README](/workspace/README.md). The add, finish, direct-link, and restart flows passed the test suite.

item.text:
The reading log is ready. The home page shows separate **Currently reading** and **Finished** shelves. You can add a book with notes, mark it finished, and open its own page to view its details or copy a shareable link. Books are saved to `data/books.json` and remain there after a restart.

Run `npm start`, then open `http://localhost:3000`. Setup details are in the [README](/workspace/README.md). The add, finish, direct-link, and restart flows passed the test suite.
